source_documentation.guide: Junos OS System Logging documentation / System Log Messages Reference
source_documentation.note: Junos does not use a Fortinet-style type/subtype model. Logs are organized by facility, severity, and a per-process/daemon message-tag catalog, which is the closest analog to 'subtypes'. The full System Log Messages Reference spans 100+ process chapters across all Junos platforms (routers, SRX security, mobile, etc.); the 'message_tag_categories' list below is filtered to daemons/processes relevant to an EX-series switch.

facilities.description: The Junos OS kernel performs actions and encounters errors.
Operations and errors occurring in user-space processes.
System daemons perform actions or encounter errors.
FTP performs actions or encounters errors.
Network Time Protocol performs actions or encounters errors.
Events related to dynamic flow capture.
Local external applications perform actions or encounter errors.
The firewall filter performs packet filtering actions.
The Packet Forwarding Engine performs actions or encounters errors.
Specified configuration is invalid on the device type.
Changes to the Junos OS configuration.
Commands issued through CLI or NETCONF clients.

severity_levels.description: System panic or other condition that causes the device to stop functioning.
Conditions that require immediate correction, such as a corrupted system database.
Critical conditions, such as hard errors.
Error conditions, less severe than emergency/alert/critical.
Conditions that are not errors but might warrant special handling.
Events or non-error conditions of interest.

message_tag_categories.description: Message-tag categories ('subtypes') generated by processes/daemons relevant to an EX-series switch. Each category has its own catalog of individual message tags (e.g. UI_COMMIT, LACPD_TIMEOUT) documented in the full System Log Messages Reference. Not exhaustive — Junos-wide the reference covers 100+ categories across all platforms.

categories.name: Chassis daemon
categories.covers: Chassis/hardware events, environmental monitoring, FRU insertion/removal

categories.name: Layer-2 control protocol daemon
categories.covers: STP/RSTP/MSTP and other L2 control protocols

categories.name: Management/user interface daemon
categories.covers: CLI, commit, and configuration management events

standard_format.description: Default BSD-syslog-style Junos log message format.
standard_format.example_raw_message: Aug 21 12:36:30 router1 mgd[3046]: UI_DBASE_LOGOUT_EVENT: User 'admin' exiting configuration mode

fields.name: facility.severity
fields.description: Numeric facility and severity codes, shown only when explicit-priority is configured

fields.name: TAG
fields.description: Unique uppercase message tag (the message ID)

structured_data_format.description: RFC 5424-compliant structured-data format, enabled via the 'structured-data' statement. Adds a machine-parseable Junos-specific structured-data element.
structured_data_format.example_raw_message: <PRI>1 TIMESTAMP HOSTNAME APP-NAME PROCID MSGID [junos@2636.1.1 pid="3046" process-name="mgd"] MESSAGE-TEXT

fields.name: TIMESTAMP
fields.description: Full ISO-8601 timestamp including year and milliseconds

fields.name: STRUCTURED-DATA
fields.description: Junos-specific SD-ID (enterprise number 2636.1.1) with key=value parameters; additional message-specific key=value pairs appear here for some message types (e.g. flow/session log fields on security-capable platforms)

field_schema.note: Each individual message tag (e.g. UI_COMMIT, LACPD_TIMEOUT) can define additional message-specific fields/parameters beyond this common envelope, documented per tag in the official System Log Messages Reference. Not enumerated here due to volume (hundreds of message tags across all categories).
